name: Kang-Petrov Arms KP-10C 'Bullpup'
description:
The Kang-Petrov KP-10C is a compact semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm Auto, designed as a scaled-down version of their duty platform for concealed carry. The barrel is trimmed to nine centimeters and the grip shortened to accept flush-fit eight-round magazines. The result is a punchy, snappy little weapon that puts 10mm power into a package small enough for inside-waistband carry.

The Bullpup is not comfortable to shoot. The abbreviated grip makes maintaining control during rapid fire challenging, and the 10mm recoil in the lightened frame is aggressive. Kang-Petrov includes an extended pinky rest magazine baseplate in the box — a tacit admission that most shooters cannot grip the weapon adequately with the flush magazine. But comfort was never the point. The KP-10C exists for people who want 10mm stopping power and refuse to carry a full-size pistol.

The weapon has found an unexpected niche among licensed couriers who transit between district tiers carrying high-value packages. The combination of concealability and stopping power suits their specific threat profile — they need a weapon that is invisible until required and decisive when deployed.
specifications:
caliber: 10mm Auto
effective_range: 30 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 8 rounds
weight: 0.68 kg
tactical_use: A concealable pistol delivering 10mm stopping power in a compact package. The snappy recoil demands firm grip technique and limits practical rate of fire. Best suited for close-range defensive encounters where a single well-placed shot matters more than sustained fire. The compact size trades shootability for concealability.
cultural_context: The Bullpup has a reputation as an expert's carry weapon — it requires skill to shoot well, and carrying one implies confidence in one's abilities. Among licensed couriers, it has become something of a professional standard, to the point where 'packing a Bullpup' is courier slang for being properly prepared for a dangerous run.
story_hooks: A courier's Bullpup is found at a crime scene with a full magazine — fired from a weapon with different ballistics. Someone is planting couriers' weapons at murder sites.
Kang-Petrov releases a KP-10C recall after discovering that a specific ammunition brand causes catastrophic chamber failures. The ammunition brand insists their product is within spec.

physical_description.visual_profile: A stubby, aggressive wedge — bullpup-proportioned with the action pushed rearward, creating a compressed silhouette. The shortened grip and trimmed barrel give it a blunt, businesslike appearance. Visually reads as 'coiled spring' rather than elegant pistol.
physical_description.dimensions: Length: 16.5 cm | Barrel: 9 cm | Width: 3.2 cm | Height (grip): 9.8 cm
physical_description.weight_description: Deceptively dense — 680 grams feels heavier in hand than its compact profile suggests. The mass is concentrated forward around the barrel assembly, creating a front-heavy balance that demands respect during draw and presentation.
physical_description.primary_material: Steel slide with integral rail system, reinforced polymer lower receiver in high-impact engineering resin, stainless steel trigger group
physical_description.finish: Matte black slide with micro-textured DLC coating; polymer frame in dark gunmetal gray with subtle diamond-knurled sections at pressure points. Minimal gloss — strictly functional.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal and matte black primary; brushed steel takedown lever and safety selector as accent elements
physical_description.grip_texture: Aggressive — textured polymer with pronounced 45-degree diamond pattern. Sharp enough to cut skin if raked. The abbreviated grip circumference (7.6 cm) forces high hand positioning and a 'claw grip' technique.
distinctive_features: Integrated Picatinny rail under muzzle (laser/light mount)
Recessed take-down lever with Japanese-inspired clean lines
Flush-fit magazine design with sharp 8-round profile
Extended pinky-rest baseplate in glossy black polymer (included in box)
Minimal sights — low-profile fixed tritium night sights, co-witness ready
Polygonal barrel visible in slide cutaway
Crowned muzzle with subtle cosmoline patina typical of factory finish
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: KANG-PETROV ARMS etched into left side of slide in angular sans-serif font; model designation 'KP-10C' and caliber '10mm AUTO' stamped on right side just forward of trigger guard; micro-serialization laser-marked inside trigger guard housing
physical_description.condition_typical: Courier models show accelerated wear — holster rub on barrel edges, grip tape residue, scratched rail system from quick-attach optics swaps. Well-maintained but obviously field-used. A few units show scuff marks from being chambered and de-chambered repeatedly during crossing checkpoints.
